Root.triggerId / defaultTriggerId.semantic: which trigger owns the state when several triggers share one card.

Root.handle.semantic: detached triggers via PreviewCard.createHandle(); required for triggers rendered outside Root.

Root.children.semantic: render function receives the active trigger's payload.

Trigger.delay / closeDelay.semantic: hover/focus open and close delays on the trigger itself (NOT on Root).

Trigger.handle / payload.semantic: associate a detached trigger and pass data into the popup render function.

Trigger element.semantic: the trigger is a link; use `render` for framework links.

Positioner.type: UseAnchorPositioningSharedParameters (side default 'bottom', align default 'center', sideOffset, alignOffset, anchor, arrowPadding, collisionAvoidance, collisionBoundary, collisionPadding, sticky, positionMethod, disableAnchorTracking)
Positioner.semantic: standard popup positioning; also exposes --positioner-width/--positioner-height and --transform-origin.

Popup.semantic: content container; docs size it with --popup-width/--popup-height and animate with data-starting-style/data-ending-style.

Viewport.children.semantic: transition container required only when one card has multiple triggers, content changes per trigger and switching is animated; state exposes activationDirection/transitioning/instant ('dismiss'|'focus').

Portal.keepMounted / container.semantic: Portal keeps the popup mounted while hidden when requested.

Arrow / Backdrop.semantic: Backdrop is presentational only (this popup is not interactive).

dataAttributes: Popup: data-open, data-closed, data-starting-style, data-ending-style, data-side, data-align
Positioner: data-open, data-closed, data-anchor-hidden, data-side, data-align
Arrow: data-open, data-closed, data-side, data-align, data-uncentered
Viewport: data-current, data-previous, data-activation-direction, data-transitioning, data-instant ('dismiss'|'focus')
renderProp: Shared `render` contract on every part (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement, plus state-driven className/style); the docs use render={<a/>}-style swapping for framework links on Trigger. Detached triggers use PreviewCard.createHandle() passed to Root.handle and Trigger.handle. Custom primitives: useRender; merging: mergeProps/mergePropsN.
controlled: `open` / `defaultOpen` + `onOpenChange(open, eventDetails)` and `onOpenChangeComplete(open)`; multi-trigger controlled mode pairs `open` with `triggerId` / `defaultTriggerId`; `actionsRef` -> { unmount, close }; Handle exposes imperative control for detached triggers.
keyboard: The popup is deliberately NOT keyboard- or screen-reader-navigable: the docs' usage guidelines require keeping the link as the only accessible interface and putting all previewed information at the destination (content is a visual progressive enhancement for sighted pointer/keyboard users). Opening: hover or focus of the trigger after `delay` (600 ms default); closing after `closeDelay` (300 ms default), on dismiss (Escape/outside press) or when focus leaves — the Viewport's data-instant is 'dismiss' | 'focus', i.e. instant transitions for those two interactions. No typeahead, no arrow-key navigation inside the card.
notableDifferences: React Aria's HoverCard equivalent maps to Root+Trigger+Positioner+Popup, but here the delays live on the Trigger (`delay` 600 / `closeDelay` 300) and the Trigger must be an <a> (link), matching the 'preview of a link destination' semantics.
Content is intentionally non-interactive/non-announced (docs: 'preview card content is not touch, keyboard or screen reader navigable') — do not port interactive controls into it.

Multiple/detached triggers are first-class (createHandle + Root.handle/triggerId + Trigger.payload with a payload-render-function child), and animated switching between triggers requires the dedicated `Viewport` part (data-current/data-previous/data-activation-direction/data-transitioning).

State is data-* based: data-popup-open on the trigger, data-open/data-closed/data-starting-style/data-ending-style/data-side/data-align on popup/positioner, data-uncentered on the arrow; there is no data-focus-visible/data-hovered.
